title: fix(cli): a refused Console mount answers 503 naming the remedy, not a bare 404
body:
Fixes #22420
Clause-②: no
A refused Console mount answers `503` naming the remedy instead of the router's bare `404` on the same routes, as the not-built position already does (PR #22419, `Clause-②: no`). No accepted input, key or export changes.

## What changes

`os serve` sometimes decides not to serve the Console. On two of those boots, the HTTP surface used to say nothing: `GET /_console/` and `GET /` answered the router's bare `404 ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND`, which looks the same as a wrong URL. Both boots now mount a responder on the routes the not-built answer (PR #22419) already uses:

- `GET /_console/*` answers `503`, `text/plain`, `no-store`. The body is the remedy the boot message prints, rendered without absolute host paths.
- `GET /` and `GET /_console` redirect to `/_console/`, as they do when the Console is served.

| position | terminal | HTTP before | HTTP after |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| package resolves, no built `dist/` | `formatConsoleDistMissingWarning` | `503` + redirects (PR #22419) | unchanged |
| dev, built `dist/.objectui-sha` is not the repo pin | `formatConsoleShaDriftRefusal` (byte-identical) | bare `404` | `503` naming `pnpm objectui:build`, both SHAs and `OS_ALLOW_CONSOLE_DRIFT=1`; the pin file is named without its absolute path; `/` redirects |
| package does not resolve at all (`consolePath` null, Console enabled) | nothing | bare `404` | the not-built warning's null arm (``Console package `@objectstack/console` not found``, then the reinstall sentence); `503` saying the Console is not installed; `/` redirects |
| `--no-ui` / `--no-console` | the operator's choice | bare `404` | bare `404`, by design |

Files:

- `packages/cli/src/utils/console.ts`:
  - `createConsoleUnavailablePlugin` (not exported) is now the ONE route-mounting body. Before, that body was inline in `createConsoleNotBuiltPlugin`.
  - Two responders delegate to it. `createConsoleNotBuiltPlugin(consolePath: string | null)` is unchanged except that it now accepts `null`. `createConsoleShaDriftRefusalPlugin(drift)` is new.
  - `describeConsoleShaDrift(drift, hostPaths)` (not exported) is the drift refusal's text below its headline. Both the terminal block and the HTTP answer render it.
  - `describeConsoleDistMissing` (the not-built picker) gains a `null` arm.
- `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts`, Console mount branch only:
  - the drift arm now mounts the drift responder;
  - the not-built arm is now `else if (consoleEnabled)`, so it also covers `consolePath === null`.
  - Outside the branch, the import list gains one name.
- `packages/cli/src/utils/console-route-ledger.ts`: the `family` (now `console-static | console-unavailable`) and the `note` of `GET /`, `GET /_console` and `GET /_console/*` name every responder that mounts them.
- Tests:
  - `console.sha-drift.test.ts`: the drift responder on a real Hono app, from a fixture tree with a made-up pin and stamp.
  - `console.not-built.test.ts`: the `null` position.
  - `test/published-subpath-console.pin.test.ts`: `INTERNAL_SINCE_RETIREMENT` records the new internal export. The module's own partition pin requires this. The `./console` barrel still publishes exactly three names.
- `.changeset/22420-console-drift-responder.md`: `@objectstack/cli` patch.

## Mechanism hypotheses, measured

- **H1, confirmed.** The branch at `serve.ts:4961` (base `4638625e07`) printed `formatConsoleShaDriftRefusal` on `refusedForDrift && consoleDrift` and mounted nothing. The no-dist arm mounted `createConsoleNotBuiltPlugin(consolePath)`. Measured live (below): drift answered `404 ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` at `/_console/`, `/` and `/_console`.
- **H2, done as "a sibling that shares its route mounting".** There is one route-mounting body. Each position has one picker:
  - not-built: `describeConsoleDistMissing`;
  - drift: `describeConsoleShaDrift`.

  The terminal and HTTP forms render the same picker output. The not-built warning, the drift refusal and the drift advisory render byte-identical to base: a script printed all three for a fixed drift from a BASE worktree and from HEAD, and the two outputs have the same sha256, `a9a832a6aa7d…`.
- **H3, confirmed.** The refusal names `drift.pinFile`, an absolute path. The HTTP form writes `.objectui-sha at the checkout root` instead, and the terminal keeps the path. The SHAs stay in both, because they are commits of the public objectui repository. Ablation: making the HTTP form name `drift.pinFile` turns exactly one pin red, "with only the absolute pin-file path left out" (1 failed / 13 passed). The mutation and its restore were both proven on disk by `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (blob `e8dd212b0e75` → `5c5be9625144` → back to `e8dd212b0e75`, `git diff HEAD` empty).
- **H4, covered in this PR, with no second remedy picker.** When `consolePath` is `null`, the install is one step past an install with no `dist/`: `@objectstack/console` is a hard dependency of `@objectstack/cli`. The existing picker's install arm already names the fix for that ("reinstall it at the same version as the CLI"). So `describeConsoleDistMissing` gains a `null` arm. It changes only what it says is missing (`Console package ... not found` instead of `Console dist not found`), and its reinstall sentence is the same; a pin compares the two tails. The responder is the same `createConsoleNotBuiltPlugin`, with the headline "is not installed".
  - Reach is **NOT MEASURED** live, because it cannot be reached inside this repository. The CLI always resolves its own workspace `packages/console`. Measured: a fixture with no console package in its `node_modules` still resolved the workspace package, and the boot took the not-built arm.
  - The position is pinned in-process (`createConsoleNotBuiltPlugin(null)` on a real Hono app).

## Live measurement: before and after

The harness boots `bin/run-dev.js serve --dev` through tsx, using an `OS_ARTIFACT_PATH` artifact from a scratch project. That project's `node_modules/@objectstack/console` is a fixture dist, and its own `.objectui-sha` is a fixture pin (`aaaaaaaaaaaa…`, stamp `bbbbbbbbbbbb…`). The live pin is never used. Each child was stopped by PID.

| case | `GET /_console/` | `GET /` | `GET /_console` |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| drift, base `4638625e07` | `404` `ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` JSON | `404` `ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` | `404` |
| drift, head `9cadb71c00` | `503` `text/plain` `no-store`, refusal text, 0 occurrences of the scratch path | `302` to `/_console/` | `302` to `/_console/` |
| matching sha (control), base and head | `200` SPA shell | `302` | `302` |
| `--no-console` (control), base and head | `404` `ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` | `404` | `404` |
| package without `dist/` (neighbour), head | `503` not-built answer | `302` | `302` |

The drift answer on head:

```text
The ObjectStack Console here was built from a different objectui commit than this checkout pins, so this dev server refuses to serve it at /_console/.

      pinned  (.objectui-sha at the checkout root):              objectui@aaaaaaaaaaaa
      built   (console/dist/.objectui-sha): objectui@bbbbbbbbbbbb

    packages/console/dist is a gitignored local build that 'turbo run build' does NOT refresh,
    ...
        pnpm objectui:build
    ...
    To boot anyway with the stale bundle: OS_ALLOW_CONSOLE_DRIFT=1 — the API still serves either way.

Then restart the server.
```

## Tests and gates

All readings below are against head `9cadb71c00`, and every lock-held run printed `VERDICT command-exit 0` unless stated otherwise.

- **Red against base.** `console.ts` was restored to `4638625e07` (blob `0a8b6a55bd46` proven on disk, then restored by trap to the HEAD blob `e8dd212b0e75`, with `git diff HEAD` empty). Then 2 files failed and 11 new pins never passed:
  - the drift block failed with `createConsoleShaDriftRefusalPlugin is not a function`;
  - the `null` block failed with `The "path" argument must be of type string. Received null`.

  The 18 pre-existing tests stayed green.
- **New and touched pins:** `console.not-built.test.ts`, `console.sha-drift.test.ts`, `console-route-ledger.conformance.test.ts` and `test/console-resolve.test.ts` passed, 4 files and 62 tests. `test/published-subpath-console.pin.test.ts` (whose partition check reads the packed `.d.ts`), `test/vitest-tiers-partition.test.ts` and the ledger conformance passed, 3 files and 54 tests.
- **cli:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` passed: `tsc --noEmit`, and `check:test-typecheck` on `tsconfig.test.json` with its debt unchanged (3 files, 28 errors held).
- **cli unit layer** (`vitest run --project unit`): 276 files, 4086 tests passed.
- **cli integration layer** (`--project integration`, run locally because `serve.ts` is a spawn entry): 102 files, 945 passed and 2 skipped.
- **Dogfood.** The one dogfood file that reads `/_console`, `showcase-public-form-redirect.dogfood.test.ts`, imports `utils/console.ts` as source, so it ran locally: 9 of 9 passed. No other file under `packages/qa/dogfood` names `_console`, per `git grep`.
- **Lint, a proven narrowing** (the full `pnpm lint` is CI's):
  1. Population: eslint's own config. `--print-config` resolves all 6 touched `.ts` files into linted config objects with 5 or 6 rules each.
  2. Count: the `--format json` output reports 6 files, 0 errors and 0 warnings.
  3. Invariance: `eslint.config.mjs` never enables type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`, no typed rules), and its local plugins are per-file AST rules. So this diff cannot change the verdict on any untouched file.
- **Gates:**
  - `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, re-derived at `9cadb71c00` with no paths, lists 67 commands: the dispatched 66 plus `pnpm check:cli-test-child-env`, because of the pin-test edit.
  - All 67 ran.
  - `--ran` reconciliation: "67 derived, 67 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN".
  - `check:i18n-coverage` first refused with exit 3 ("COULD NOT MEASURE", because `@objectstack/connector-slack` was unbuilt). After the build it named, it re-ran: "OK (13 config(s), 621 baselined untranslated string(s), none new)".
  - `check:type-check-debt` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` ran last, after every locked suite, and both passed.
- **`main`:** `origin/main` (`6a3f82efa7`) has moved since the base, but no new commit touches a file in this diff, and `git merge-tree` is clean. So there is no merge (per the fence).

## Acceptance notes

- **Stale prose, outside this card's surface, not edited.**
  - The header of `console-route-ledger.conformance.test.ts` says both factories in `utils/console.ts` "return early … unless a resolvable HTTP server AND a built `dist/` exist". That has been false for the not-built factory since PR #22419, and it is false for the drift responder here. The census reads source, so the claim does not affect any verdict.
  - The ledger header's SCOPE paragraph ("four routes across two plugin factories") is dated by its own commit, `2ba4329e`.
  - Neither is a defect. Carrier: whoever next edits those files.
- **Banner.** On a refused boot, the ready banner shows no Console link: it prints one only when `ConsoleUI` is loaded (`serve.ts`, outside the fence). That matches the not-built position and is unchanged.
- **`GET /forms/:slug`.** It is still mounted only with a served Console, so on any refused boot it falls through to `404`. This is PR #22419's observation, unchanged.
- **No boot-level pin was added.** This follows PR #22419. The pins are in-process on a real Hono app, and `serve.ts`'s wiring is proven by the live before/after table above. A spawning pin would put one more `serve` boot into the per-PR integration layer (or into the nightly tier, if it were named `.e2e`).
